Class AsyncFramework.AsyncJob

public class AsyncFramework.AsyncJob

Wrapper class for managing asynchronous job instances. Provides methods to submit jobs for immediate execution or enqueue them to the in-memory queue for batch persistence. Each instance maintains a single AsyncJob__c record that can be configured via AsyncJobBuilder.

Methods

public String enqueue()

Enqueues the job to the in-memory ASYNC_QUEUE for batch persistence via flush() operation. This method allows multiple jobs to be queued before saving to reduce DML operations. Resets the job instance after enqueuing to allow reuse.

Returns:
    The JobKey__c identifier of the enqueued job.

public String publish()

Persists the job as an AsyncJob__c record with Published status, then publishes an AsyncJobEvent__e platform event. The subscriber (AsyncJobEventSubscriberHandler) executes the job and updates the record to Processing with the system JobId__c, enabling tracking via collectJobInfo() and getJobInfo().

Returns:
    The JobKey__c identifier of the published job.

Since:
    03/08/2026

private void resetJob()

Resets the current job instance to default state with a new unique JobKey__c. Generates a new UUID for JobKey__c and JobName__c fields.

public String submit()

Submits the job for immediate processing. Saves the job record to database and attempts immediate execution if the ExecuteAfter__c time has been reached. Resets the job instance after successful submission to allow reuse.

Returns:
    The JobKey__c identifier of the submitted job.
